Job opportunity: 
 We are looking for a candidate for the position of IT Help Desk Support which should
 If you are passionate about IT field we look forward to having you on our team.
 Technical Requirements: 
Strong hands-on experience with Windows OS installation, configuration and troubleshooting.
Practical experience with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory and Microsoft 365 Admin Center.
Hands-on understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN, Wi-Fi and basic VLAN concepts.
Experience troubleshooting switches, routers, wireless access points and general office network connectivity.
Experience with endpoint/device provisioning, software deployment, patching and corporate security controls. Microsoft Intune experience is strongly preferred.
Experience with IT ticketing / Service Desk systems and working within defined escalation and support procedures.
Experience with IT asset management, including maintaining accurate asset records, inventory tracking, device assignment, lifecycle activities and periodic/cyclical physical inventory.
Experience maintaining Service Desk documentation, procedures and knowledge base articles.
Hands-on experience with corporate printing systems and multifunction printers, including print/scan troubleshooting and secure print service management.
Hands-on experience with IP camera / CCTV systems, including basic configuration, connectivity and troubleshooting.
Experience supporting card-based personnel attendance / access control systems and their related devices and connectivity.
Experience with meeting-room and video-conferencing equipment, peripherals and AV troubleshooting.
Basic understanding of endpoint security, access management, MFA and corporate information-security practices.
Ability to perform structured troubleshooting using logs and diagnostic tools rather than relying only on standard user-level fixes.
Experience monitoring relevant Service Desk metrics and KPIs and contributing to service quality and resolution performance improvements.
Experience coordinating with external vendors for IT maintenance, support, purchases and infrastructure-related activities.
 Other Requirements: 
Good command of written and spoken English.
Strong communication, ownership and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently, follow Global IT standards and coordinate with central IT teams and external vendors when escalation is required.
Proactive and responsible approach, with attention to documentation and follow-up.
Experience with Microsoft Intune / Endpoint management.
Experience with Fortinet or similar Firewall/VPN environments.
Windows Server knowledge.
PowerShell or scripting knowledge is an advantage.
Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Fundamentals, CompTIA A+/Network+ or equivalent
